races.title: BAR 1 Casino Claiming Race
races.verdict: REJOINDER hasn't looked suited by the drop to the minimum trip on each of his last 2 starts, so is afforded another chance to confirm his earlier Curragh promise now tackling 7f for the first time. Chicago Caray rates next best ahead of Let Me Free . Support for either of the newcomers Present Perfect and Pal of Mine would also look significant. REJOINDER (IRE) CHICAGO CARAY LET ME FREE (IRE)

races.title: Campbell & Haughey Solicitors Nursery Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: This looks an excellent opportunity for INVINCIBLE IRISH who brings easily the most solid profile to the table and he'll find this much less demanding than the assignment he faced when third over 5f here last week. Scarlet Dream and nursery debutant Mirissa Beach may offer chief resistance. INVINCIBLE IRISH (IRE) SCARLET DREAM (IRE) MIRISSA BEACH (IRE)

races.title: Killowen Contracts Handicap
races.verdict: An ultra-competitive sprint in which it could pay to side with GO ATHLETICO , who is clearly not the force of old but fared better dropped in grade when runner-up in a C&D claimer under this rider earlier in the month. Back in a handicap, he can get the better of My Cubby Bear , who failed to build on her return but is one of the least exposed. Stable-switcher Saint Acclaim and Thaloria are another couple to consider, as well. GO ATHLETICO (FR) MY CUBBY BEAR (IRE) SAINT ACCLAIM (IRE)
